title: Defensive Coding (Frontend)
description: API payloads may be partial, null, or wrong-typed. Guard every access. See project.invariants.yaml → frontend.defensive_arrays.

rules.message: `.toFixed()` called without numeric guard — runtime crash if value is null/string.
rules.remediation: Wrap with `typeof x === 'number' ? x.toFixed(2) : '...'` before calling toFixed.

rules.message: Array method on `.data` without Array.isArray guard — crashes when backend returns {} or null.
TypeScript non-null assertion (`!.`) bypasses type safety — risky on backend data.
rules.remediation: Replace with optional chaining (`?.`) + explicit fallback.

rules.message: JSON.parse without try/catch — malformed input crashes the call site.
rules.remediation: Wrap with try/catch or use a safe-parse helper.
